title: The same moves while an editor runs design-time builds into obj (VS Code C# Dev Kit, Visual Studio): one before every save, and one during the restart

steps.title: A button with a Click handler, both files in one save

edits.text:
private int _moves;

    private void OnMove(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) => StatusText.Text = $"moved {++_moves}";

steps.title: Ctrl+R restarts
steps.note: a design-time build runs while winapp rebuilds the app. Both write the same obj files, so the rebuild can fail (CS1697, then a CS1061 in generated code); winapp then says another build may have run at the same time, and the next save recovers (a known limit)
